title.narrative: Walk the Talk: Making Education Work for Sustainable Development - Plus Fresh, Minus Trash

description.narrative: At this pilot project we want to create a greater focus on environmental issues at universities in Ukraine. Through snowflake organization we aim to create five different climate campaigns, and educate more than a 100 SD Platform activists in organizing, campaigning and climate political issues. The pilot project consists of four steps, the first being a joint bootcamp in Denmark during DSU Easter seminar, step two of a Trainers of Trainers action camp in Kiev, step three of five local actions camps at universities around in Ukraine and step four of the five local climate campaigns. Our aim of the project is both to increase organizations capacity of SD Platform, and to engage local university students and the climate political debate.
